notes.title: Patch 1.2 now available!
notes.notes:
I've just released a new update for Trash Squad. There is really a lot of content available, so look at the list below, to see what's new.


    German translation -  Special thanks to: sePL80, Spiffosi, °¤°I3ysttro© aka Bysttro, Meatbug
    4 new dangerous bosses
    15 minibosses to beat
    13 new weapons
    7 new random events to encounter
    3 powerful passive items to collect
    3 mercenaries to hire - Knight, Drunkard, Robot
    2 secret levels 
    1 starting item
    1 new character to unlock - Poisioner

Thanks for your support.

notes.title: First update is now out!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Patch 1.1 has been just released. Below is a list of changes and improvements:

Alternative look of main locations.
Timer in left upper corner. 
Retry button. Return to game quickly after your death.
Decreased number of levels needed to complete the game.
Modifications of talents and items statistics.
Added 'skip intro' option.
